subject.title: feat(ui): manage MCP servers directly from Settings → MCP

question: Should Settings → MCP become the primary in-product surface for directly managing configured MCP servers while Plugins remains the connector-discovery surface?
rationale: This is a new user-facing configuration-management workflow that intentionally changes the owner boundary between two existing Settings surfaces; the protected maintainer label requires explicit human confirmation.

options.title: Adopt Settings ownership
options.body: Approve direct MCP server management in Settings while retaining Plugins for one-click connector discovery and the shared policy helper for both views.

options.title: Keep Plugins as manager
options.body: Retain the existing Plugins-only management ownership and limit Settings → MCP to its current read-only summary and configuration editor.

options.title: Narrow the split
options.body: Approve the shared helper but define a smaller Settings action set before merge, such as add and edit only while connector-specific removal remains in Plugins.

recommendation.title: Adopt Settings ownership
recommendation.body: Approve direct MCP server management in Settings while retaining Plugins for one-click connector discovery and the shared policy helper for both views.

likelyOwner.reason: The available commit history identifies this contributor as the person who implemented the Settings/Plugins ownership split.
